# SaltWatch Card 0.6.2

SaltWatch Card now speaks Danish and automatically follows Danish Home
Assistant user profiles.

## What changed

- Added complete Danish translations for the card and graphical editor.
- Added support for `da` and Danish regional language tags such as `da-DK`.
- Translated status, salt-level, forecast, setup, validation, and action text.
- Uses the concise Danish label **Lavgrænse** for the low-salt threshold marker.
- Added Danish to the interactive demo and language documentation.

The initial Danish translation was created with AI assistance. Catalog
completeness, automatic language switching, and rendered layouts were then
verified by automated tests. Suggestions from native Danish speakers are very
welcome.

## Validation

- 54 unit tests passed.
- 45 browser tests passed across desktop and mobile Chromium, including Danish
  language switching and narrow-card layout checks; one desktop-only mobile
  scroll test was skipped as intended.
- The production TypeScript and Vite build passed.
